newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers steady, busy pre-holiday rush.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers steady, busy pre-holiday rush.

text.p: Rotterdam bunkers were steady on Tuesday despite a rush of business ahead of public holidays in the Netherlands on Wednesday and much of Europe on Thursday.
Total ARA bunker volume exceeded 20,000 tonnes including about four large enquiries, suppliers said.
"It's very active. A lot of people are just placing orders at the last moment," one supplier said.
Rotterdam bunkers were quoted at around $84 fob by most, although two players fixed much of the business at about $82. One appeared to have plenty of product to shift.
Barges were also fairly hard to find.
Low Rhine water levels have kept many vessels busy heading to and from Germany.
Hamburg prices dipped to narrow the Rotterdam-Hamburg differential which drew some, but not many, buyers.
Mediterranean fuel oil was also unchanged while gas oil dipped by $1 in many ports. Demand improved in most areas.
In Egyptian ports product was amply available.

In South Africa prices were broadly steady. However, one major temporarily pulled out of the market after producing incompatible product. Others were not taking large orders for at least a week. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
